goal: Einen sicheren projektlokalen Chromium-Bootstrap und Lookup fuer das bestehende I172-Gate bereitstellen.

guide_delta.summary: Ein gepinntes Browserarchiv kann nach SHA-256-Pruefung sicher in einen lokalen Cache installiert werden; ohne passenden Fingerabdruck oder freigegebenen Host bleibt die Installation geschlossen.

direct_dependencies: I172 Chromium gate and CDP harness
tests_required: compile browser installer, installer tests and I172 wrapper
SHA-256 mismatch and archive traversal negative tests
tests_explicitly_not_run: real I172 Chromium screenshot gate remains blocked until a pinned archive or executable is supplied
product tests because product runtime is unchanged
storage deep gate because repository and schema are unchanged
full suite because only browser test infrastructure changes
risks: a compromised archive must never be accepted without the pinned SHA-256
archive paths or symlinks could otherwise escape the local cache
a stale or partial cache could otherwise be mistaken for a verified browser
the real screenshot gate remains unavailable until an external artifact is provided
non_changes: no browser binary or archive committed
no product runtime or UI change
no README, TODO or roadmap progress change
no persistence, repository or schema change
expected_side_effects: a pinned Chromium archive can be installed into an ignored project-local cache
I172 can use an explicit or receipt-verified local browser before PATH lookup
I172 remains blocked while the lockfile is unconfigured and no external executable is supplied
